text: Verity Sample Holdings - Annual Report 2024. Revenue grew 42 percent to 12.4 million dollars in 2024. Operating margin improved to 18 percent, up from 11 percent in the prior year. The company operates in three regions: North America, Europe and Asia. The board approved a dividend of 0.25 dollars per share. Headcount at year end was 214 employees.

Board meeting notes, November 2024. The board approved a 38 percent revenue increase target for 2025. The target assumes no further hiring in the first half of the year. Hiring was frozen in the third quarter of 2024.

Product memo: Project Lantern. Project Lantern launches in March 2025 with a six month pilot. The pilot includes 500 users across two pilot customers. Success is measured by weekly active use above 60 percent.
